ask_me.section: break 2 (~269-272 s): "Ask me something. Then wait." in my homemade voice; the quietest picture

ask_me_hold.section: hold after ask_me (starts on its last frame): stillness, the breath, the gaze on the lens

dark_groove.section: the choruses in the hole (79.3, 174.9, 272.3 s): the darkwave groove

fence_hands.section: verse 5, the evening news: her hands on the data-centre fence (fence plane in the README)

fence.note: film metres at scale 0.87, her origin = the floor between her feet, facing +z; palms 2 cm (rig) behind the wire plane, curled fingers through it; the hands at the top of the chest, just under the shoulder line (her face hangs between the shoulders: any higher and the hooked fingers cover her mouth from the front)

fence_hands_hold.section: hold after fence_hands (starts on its last frame): hands hooked, she breathes

look_up.section: the hole: looking up at the ring of billboards on the rim (~50 deg up); the outro "she looks up"

look_up_hold.section: hold after look_up (starts on its last frame): the gaze travels round the ring

not_that.section: pre-heard captions struck through; the final chorus "Not your god, not your engine..."

not_that_mirror.section: mirror of not_that: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)

salute_abort.section: verse 2, the gold corridor: the cap is placed, the salute starts and is not finished

sing_low.section: the verses: a sung line, the hand opening on beat 1 and closing on beat 3

sing_low_mirror.section: mirror of sing_low: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)

still_breathe.section: the hush: break 2 near-silence, the outro, anywhere the city goes quiet
still_breathe.notes: same stance as every clip; use it as the neutral between gestures

turn_it_down.section: every "could you turn it down?" (99.0, 109.2, 292.9, 303.2 s): the signature gesture

turn_it_down_hold.section: hold after turn_it_down (starts on its last frame): the room is quieter
